reels.caption:
Jungle House 🌳🤍🌱
Architect & Interior Designer: @miladeshtiyaghi

This project is a deeply personal expression of my architectural philosophy—minimal, intentional, and intrinsically connected to nature. Nestled on a verdant slope at the foot of a mountain range, the house was envisioned as a quiet gesture to the landscape, not a disruption.

Rather than imposing on the terrain, the structure appears to hover just above it—light, effortless, and respectful of the natural contours. Its clean, elongated form becomes a lens, framing the surrounding jungle like a living canvas. By slightly lifting the volume off the earth, we preserved the integrity of the site while enhancing the home's ethereal presence.

Floor-to-ceiling glazing dissolves the boundary between inside and out, immersing the interior in views and natural light. The interior design follows the same ethos—subdued tones, soft textures, minimal furnishings—all chosen to recede, allowing nature to lead the experience.

Every line, every material, and every proportion was chosen with clarity and calm in mind. This house is more than a dwelling—it's a meditative space, a sanctuary that embraces stillness and slowness. A place to retreat, to breathe, and to simply exist within the rhythm of the land.

Would you live here?

#architecture #minimalism #natureconnected #designinspiration #quietluxury modernretreat jungleliving
